# UI Integration Requirements Checklist: Phase 1 Real Data Layer

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness and clarity of requirements for UI integration with the new API data hooks.
**Created**: 2026-06-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements explicitly defined for the UI state when the data hook returns a network timeout but no cache is available? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the exact fallback UI specified for when an individual content item (e.g., thumbnail) fails to load within the list? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how the UI should behave if the allowed categories list is updated while the child is actively browsing? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the "Play outside" empty state requirement clearly differentiated from a "Loading" state? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK005 Are loading/skeleton state visual requirements defined for all four content screens (Stories, Games, Videos, Creative)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Are pagination or data-limit requirements defined for the fetched content lists? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements specified for pulling fresh data (e.g., pull-to-refresh) in the UI? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Are error messaging requirements documented for scenarios where the API hook fails? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the UI rendering timing quantified (e.g., "fast loading" vs specific milliseconds) for cached vs live data? [Clarity, Spec §Performance]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the definition of "locally cached content" unambiguously specified (e.g., in-memory vs disk persist)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the exact text copies for the "friendly offline message" explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are the data hook integration patterns required to be identical across all four content screens? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the requirement for "Offline access" consistently apply to the Parent Settings screen as it does to the Child UI? [Consistency, Gap]
